verdict.rationale: Rootly Workflows are an automation engine that runs actions automatically or manually based on trigger events and run conditions. Its 152 action types include creating incident Slack/Teams channels, updating stakeholders and filing tickets (e.g. Jira), which covers the core of auto-triggered response steps. Diagnostics appear through AI SRE investigations and the AWS connector, but are not shown as workflow steps. missing for 10: an explicit runbook object that attaches to incidents, explicit task-assignment actions, diagnostics shown as automated workflow steps, independent or hands-on corroboration.
